article.title: What’s the deal with productivity?
article.author: Editor
article.content: The bosses are trying to convince workers that lower corporate taxes, fewer regulations and workers’ rights, and less union power would be good for real wages. What they really want is more profits. The post What’s the deal with productivity? appeared first on MR Online .
source_folders: 06_左派ニュース・社会主義戦略
